observation: The first repository self-dogfood run attempted to invoke vendor/bin/agent-loop and failed because a Composer root package does not install its own binary into vendor/bin. The clean consumer release-set scenario did provide vendor/bin/agent-loop, so the two execution contexts have intentionally different entrypoints.

evidence.command: Agent-loop shapes itself / Installed release-set dogfood
evidence.summary: The repository self-run became green after switching to php bin/agent-loop, while the independent installed-consumer gate continued to pass through vendor/bin/agent-loop.

hypothesis: Dogfood that conflates repository-under-development execution with installed-consumer execution can fail for packaging reasons or accidentally stop testing one of those boundaries.
validated_conclusion: Repository-local self-dogfood uses php bin/agent-loop. Installed-consumer dogfood separately proves vendor/bin/agent-loop. Keep both because they validate different packaging boundaries.
